noun_definition: Fallback avatar refers to the default image displayed for a user when they are offline and cannot show their actual profile picture in the chat interface.
Background refers to the visual color that appears behind the fallback avatar when it is highlighted in the suggestion list during user selection.
Color refers to the visual attribute of the background of the fallback avatar that should be distinguishable when a user is highlighted in the suggestion list.
Selection highlight refers to the visual indication that appears when a user is selected or emphasized in a suggestion list, specifically in the context of searching for users with fallback avatars.
